metadata.case_name: KHAN IRRAM v. WAI HING ENGINEERING CO LTD

injuries.description: fracture at the distal phalange of the left ring finger
source: X-ray of the left ring finger detected a fracture at the distal phalange.
Mr. Khan sustained injuries mainly to his left ring finger.

injuries.description: injuries to three ulnar fingers of his left hand
injuries.body_part: three ulnar fingers of left hand
source: the broken piece of the blade hit his left finger(s) and he sustained injuries to three ulnar fingers of his left hand as a result.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: distal phalange of his left ring finger was swollen with bruises
bruise was found underneath the fingernail of his left ring finger
pain and tender at the tip of the ring finger with hard contact
discomfort and weakness over his left hand up to today
left middle finger had scratches below the fingernail

treatments_received.treatment: A & E attendance, x-ray and discharge with analgesic drug
source: He went to the A & E Department of Ruttonjee Hospital in the following morning after the accident.
X-ray of the left ring finger detected a fracture at the distal phalange.
He was discharged on the same day with analgesic drug.

treatments_received.treatment: sick leave from 5th August 2006 up to 19th August 2006 (15 days)
source: He was given sick leave from 5th August 2006 up to 19th August 2006 (15 days).

losses.description: reduced grip power, discomfort and weakness of the left hand and residual effects at the tip of the left ring finger

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: can no longer play cricket and volleyball after the accident
disadvantage on the labour market; may suffer longer periods of unemployment; loss of earning capacity assessed at 0.5% by Dr. Chun; global award under this head $40,000
